concept.hr: Kako se neuspjeh širi skriptom, i cjevovod koji javlja uspjeh iako je pao
concept.en: How failure propagates, and a pipeline that reports success while failing

summary.hr: Skripta redak po redak: status svake naredbe, && i || koji ga čitaju, set -e s tri iznimke i pipefail koji otkriva pad usred cjevovoda.
summary.en: A script line by line: each command's status, && and || reading it, set -e with its three exceptions, and pipefail exposing a failure mid-pipeline.

concept.hr: S pipefail cjevovod vraća status člana koji je pao, pa set -e staje
concept.en: With pipefail the pipeline returns the failed member's status, so set -e stops

title.hr: Noćni posao javlja OK, a sigurnosna kopija je krnja
title.en: The nightly job says OK, and the backup is truncated

concept.hr: Pad usred cjevovoda bez pipefail: status 0, poruka OK, datoteka od 1,2 MB
concept.en: A failure mid-pipeline without pipefail: status 0, an OK mail, a 1.2 MB file

title.en: a && b || c is not if-else

concept.hr: || se izvršava i nakon uspjeha prve naredbe, kad padne druga
concept.en: || also runs after the first command succeeds, when the second fails
